High-tech machinery, daytime shifts and plenty of opportunities. A role with perspective, a competitive salary, and the space to develop yourself. Wie zoeken we? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building you are accurate, practical and quality-oriented. You understand better than anyone how important it is that every machine delivers exactly what the customer requires. You work independently or together with colleagues on assembling and testing complex modules and systems. You solve problems quickly and proactively, and you naturally enjoy supporting your colleagues and sharing your knowledge. Technicial background or education Interest in fine mechanics and precision work Accuracy and strong attention to detail Good command of English and the ability to follow instructions Wat bieden wij je? As an assembly technician in high-tech machine building, you can of course expect something in return for your efforts. You will have a varied role in daytime shifts within a dedicated team of specialists. There is plenty of room for development, training, and career growth. In addition, you will work in a pleasant, informal environment with opportunities for team activities. A gross monthly salary between €3.000 and €4.200 based on a 40-hour week A one-year contract with the client, with prospects for a permanent position 27 vacation days and 13 additional days off Participation in the PME pension fund (Metalektro) Informal working atmosphere with opportunities for team activities Functieomschrijving As an Assembly Technician in high-tech machine building you will assemble and test advanced machines used for wafer processing with plasma technology. These machines are essential to the semiconductor industry, a vital sector powering the technology behind everything from smartphones and medical devices to cars, smart appliances and sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a cleanroom environment. Depending on the size of the machine you will either handle thbuild independently or together with one or two colleagues. While some standard machines are delivered, no two machines are ever the same since each one is fully customized to the client’s specifications. Once you know the machines inside out you will also perform the final testing and prepare the accompanying test reports, making sure the machines deliver exactly as promised. This is a highly responsible role as you will be working with precision equipment. You will also support less experienced colleagues, contributing directly to the team and the quality of the machines. Your work makes an immediate difference in the performance of these products. Assembling high-tech machines and components in a cleanroom environment Testing and inspecting the functionality of the systems Identifying and resolving technical issues during the assembly process Adapting machines to meet specific customer requirements and needs Where will you be working? You will join an innovative company in the semiconductor industry, based in Nijmegen. This high-tech organisation develops and builds machines for the global market, with locations in Europe, China and the United States. The production department in Nijmegen consists of around 20 colleagues who share a passion for technology. The atmosphere is informal and supportive – you are never on your own. Ready to take the next step as an assembly technician in high-tech? Apply today and we will get in touch with you soon.

Man-up warehouse employee - Amsterdam -  €16.16 per uur - Logistics - 38.75 hour Do you enjoy performing a variety of tasks in a warehouse with different responsibilities? As a Man-Up Employee, you are the link between the order pickers, inventory, and the packing department within the outbound process. Once all products have been sorted from the containers, any remaining stock is collected into individual boxes and placed on pallets. These pallets are moved to the storage area, where you use a man-up truck, also known as a Very Narrow Aisle (VNA) truck, to place the individual boxes in the correct storage locations. The storage racks are specifically designed to hold individual boxes rather than full pallets. This means you will actively move around the warehouse and place each box in the correct location. Your responsibilities: - Process and place stock boxes into the storage racks. - Pick and replenish boxes when stock is running low or empty in the picking department. - Use a scanner to register every box and ensure that all inventory movements are correctly recorded in the system. - Make sure products are stored accurately and efficiently. - Work closely with the order picking and packing teams to ensure a smooth outbound process.  Job Requirements  - You have a valid reachtruck certificate - You have a good command of English, both spoken and written. - You are in good physical shape - You are motivated to work - You like to work in a team - You are motivated, take initiative, and feel comfortable in an active work environment - Preferably, you have experience in logistics and are comfortable working with systems and warehouse equipment such as scanners - You work in a structured way, communicate easily with colleagues in English, and maintain an overview, even during busy periods. Sometimes something goes wrong along the way. A box doesn't arrive or a delivery is incomplete, and our client wants to know quickly what happened. Because we hold the contracts with the carriers, we are responsible for that support. As logistics support specialist, you are the link between our clients, our packing department and carriers such as DHL, DPD and UPS. You investigate, liaise with everyone involved and make sure every case is properly closed. You can start right away, or later by agreement. Tasks and responsibilities: - You handle the daily emails from clients about short deliveries and missing boxes - For each case, you work with the carrier (DHL, DPD or UPS) to find out what happened - You check with the packing department how a shipment was processed and sent - You keep the client informed about the progress and the outcome - You work closely with the packing department supervisor - Where needed, you take on other tasks on the warehouse floor  About Hartevelt Hartevelt Fashion Fulfilment is a family business that started in 1945 as a dry cleaner in Zeist. Four generations later, we are a full service fulfilment partner for fashion brands.
